title: Customer Support Representative
requiredSkills: Good verbal and written communication skills.
Flexible attitude and ability to work under pressure there may be a requirement to work beyond normal working hours on certain occasions.
Effective problem analysis and solving skills.

Work experience in E-commerce is not mandatory but preferable.
jobDescription:
